description:
DUBLIV is proud to present The Residence at College Square, a brand-new collection of premium one and two bedroom apartments located in the heart of Dublin 2, adjacent to Trinity College Dublin.

This high-end development of 57 luxury homes offers a rare opportunity to live in a refined, design-led setting within walking distance of Grafton Street, Merrion Square, and the Docklands. Every element of The Residence has been carefully considered to deliver a five-star living experience combining style, comfort, and convenience in equal measure.

Rising from the 11th to the 20th floor, these exceptional luxury apartments offer a rare vantage point over Dublin 2, with sweeping views that take in the River Liffey, Trinity College, and the dynamic cityscape beyond. Designed for those who appreciate refined living in the heart of the capital, each apartment combines elevated tranquillity with front-row access to Dublin's most iconic landmarks.

Unrivalled Amenities:

-	Elegant eleventh-floor rooftop garden and residents' lounge, offering panoramic views across the city
-	Contemporary on-site gym, exclusively for residents
-	Full-time concierge service
-	Secure underground parking (available at additional cost)
-	Pet-friendly 
-	High-speed communal WiFi in the resident lounge for work or relaxation
-	Community events 
-	Secure bicycle storage and lift access throughout

Apartment Features:

-	Bespoke interiors with luxury finishes throughout
-	Spacious open-plan layouts filled with natural light
-	Designer kitchens with integrated appliances
-	Elegant bathrooms with premium fixtures
-	Generous storage solutions in every home

Whether you're spending the day in the city centre for work or soaking up the vibrant culture, dining, and green spaces that Dublin city  has to offer, The Residence at College Square puts you right at the centre of it all.

To arrange a private viewing or to register your interest, please contact DUBLIV today.

https://theresidencecollegesquare.ie/
